name: Kate Pryde
bio: Phasing mutant introduced at thirteen as the reader's point of view; grew up on the page into a team leader, headmistress and, on Krakoa, a pirate captain. Her relationships are a map of the X-Men's generational structure: mentored by Storm and Wolverine, in love with Colossus, in conflict with Emma Frost.

continuity.name: Earth-616
continuity.description: The main Marvel Comics continuity, running continuously since Fantastic Four #1 (1961).

era.name: Claremont Era
era.description: Giant-Size X-Men #1 (1975) through Chris Claremont's departure after X-Men #3 (1991). The all-new team, Phoenix, Days of Future Past, the Brood, Inferno.

relationships.label: Decades on and off
relationships.summary: A teenage crush that became a long, intermittently written romance. Broken off in Secret Wars (1985) when Piotr fell for an alien healer; revived in Astonishing X-Men; nearly ended in marriage in X-Men Gold #30 (2018), when Kitty called it off at the altar.

events.note: Kitty, 13, is immediately smitten with Piotr.
Piotr falls for Zsaji on Battleworld; the relationship ends.
Colossus returns from apparent death; the romance restarts.
Kitty halts the wedding; Rogue and Gambit marry instead.

relationships.label: From fear to family
relationships.summary: Kitty initially recoiled from Kurt's appearance; Claremont used her growing affection for him as the story of the reader learning to see past surfaces. They are close for the rest of the run.

events.note: Kitty is frightened by Nightcrawler on first meeting.
Christmas issue: Kitty alone at the mansion, Kurt among those she now counts as family.

relationships.label: Big sister, then peer
relationships.summary: Storm was the first adult X-Man Kitty bonded with; the relationship strained when Storm's punk-era change (Uncanny X-Men #173) frightened her, and matured into equals by the time Kitty led the team.

events.note: Storm recruits Kitty in Deerfield, Illinois.
Kitty rejects Storm's new look and the two fall out.

relationships.label: Teacher, then colleague
relationships.summary: Logan trained Kitty in Japan after her kidnapping by Ogun; she is the first of his series of young protégées (later Jubilee, Armor, Laura). As an adult she ran his school after his death.

events.note: Logan rescues and retrains Kitty in Japan; she takes the name Shadowcat.
Kitty is co-headmistress of the Jean Grey School.

continuity.description: The main Marvel Comics continuity, running continuously since Fantastic Four #1 (1961).

era.name: Morrison / Whedon Era
era.description: New X-Men (2001–2004) and Astonishing X-Men (2004–2008). Emma Frost joins, Jean dies, the school becomes a school.

relationships.label: Mutual contempt, grudging respect
relationships.summary: Kitty never forgave Emma's Hellfire Club past; Whedon's Astonishing X-Men built the team's internal tension on Kitty's suspicion that Emma had not changed. Emma's later rescue of Kitty from the bullet (Uncanny X-Men #522, 2010) did not fully close the account.

events.note: Kitty is recruited specifically to keep an eye on Emma.
Emma, under the Hellfire Club's influence, turns on Kitty.
